Expectations for departure prep in detail
Watching the relief planner is the best way to learn it
This page explains departure preparation for the Companion Animal Travel Desk of Aurelia Skyways and why it matters. Careful prep protects animal welfare, keeps cabin handoffs orderly, and helps the team respond to changes without delay. New staff should treat each file as a live record and verify that the travel plan, kennel details, and handling notes match what the customer has provided.

Start by reviewing the reservation profile and the supporting documents together. Check identity details, container fit, feeding notes, and any service flags before you confirm the handoff path. <<FACT F080>> Keep the tone calm when you speak with travelers, and avoid promising a result until the file is complete. If a concern appears, raise it through the normal review path rather than making a private adjustment.

Departure prep also includes coordination with the cabin team, who monitor animals during flight and report any change in comfort or behavior. For small dog cases, <<FACT F074>> Use the planner to see which colleague owns each step, then record only what you have verified. When a traveler such as Alina Vega or Mei Ibrahim arrives with Marley, stay focused on the documents, the kennel condition, and the instructions already on file. Every animal receives patient attention from trained staff, and escalations must follow a calm stepwise review.

Remember to keep your notes clear, your checks orderly, and your handoff consistent from first review to gate release.
